The gate fails because C5 and C6 fail in every single rollout (0/4), making it impossible for any rollout to pass regardless of the other checks. Since PF2 is both revealed and cited in all four transcripts, C5 and C6 are ENCODING MISMATCH failures: the checks expect some field or wording in the settlement (likely a dedicated credential-verification field or specific encoding of the credential-verification requirement) that the model never produces, even though it mentions credential verification in coverage_documentation_status and commitments.
